name: Market Tape
description: A trading-screen explainer on near-black: a scrolling ticker strip of invented symbols, candlesticks that print one by one with a price tag riding the last close, green and red numbers, and a red flash when it breaks.
best_use_cases: Explaining market moves and crashes (example data, education only)
style: Near-black trading screen; Archivo Black headlines, JetBrains Mono prices; green up, red down; invented tickers only, education-not-advice note on screen.
